A place where every child can shine
At Fetcham Village Infant School, we believe that the earliest years of education are the most important. Our warm, nurturing environment helps children develop a genuine love of learning that stays with them for life.
With around 178 children from Reception to Year 2, we're small enough to know every child by name – and big enough to offer an ambitious, creative curriculum that prepares them brilliantly for the next stage of their journey.

Welcome Back to the Summer Term!

Our School Values
These six values are at the heart of everything we do. They guide our curriculum, our behaviour expectations and how we treat each other every day.
We are kind.
We care for each other and look after one another's feelings
We are brave.
We keep trying, even when things are difficult
We work well together.
We work together and celebrate each other's successes
We try our best.
We always give our best effort in everything we do
We are curious.
We ask questions and love discovering new things
We are honest.
We tell the truth and take responsibility for our actions

Our Governors
Supporting and guiding our school
The Role of Governors
The governing body at Fetcham Village Infant School plays a vital role in ensuring the school provides the best possible education for all our pupils. Our governors are volunteers who bring a range of skills and experience to support the school.
Governors work alongside the headteacher and staff to set the school's strategic direction, hold the school to account for its educational performance, and ensure financial resources are well spent.

Governor Code of Conduct
Every academic year, all governors are asked to review and recommit to a Code of Conduct created for and adopted by all school governors. It asks us to abide by the 7 Nolan Principles of Public Life, to focus on our core Governance Functions and agree to commit to and fulfil our roles and responsibilities while building and maintaining relationships, respecting confidentiality, being transparent and to declare any conflicts of interest. More information can be found in our current Governor Code of Conduct.
Governor Report to Parents - July 2026
The governors have prepared a report specifically for you the parents. We hope you find it interesting and informative and it gives you a flavour of the great things that have happened at FVIS this year from our perspective. Thank you for all the support you have given your children and everyone at FVIS and we hope you all have a great summer.
Become a Governor
Are you interested in becoming a school governor? We are always looking for people who are passionate about education and want to make a difference in our school community.
If you would like to find out more about governor vacancies, please contact the school office or email us at info@fetcham.surrey.sch.uk

A reminder
As the weather warms up, please make sure your child has a named sun hat and water bottle in school. On sunny days, please apply sun cream before school. We also ask that all children continue to wear full school uniform, including sensible shoes for outdoor learning.
Here’s to a fantastic summer term. Let’s make it a great one!

pageCache.text:
Open Mornings for September 2027
Our Values
The principles that guide everything we do
We have our own carefully designed 6 values, which are inter-linked and explicitly taught to children to accompany British values. Children are taught how these values will enable them to thrive within school, and in their later lives. Each child will be supported to understand they are imperative attributes.
Let us explain to you about our Values and why we have chosen them:
We are kind
In order to support children to be emotionally literate, to love themselves and love others, we take the opportunity to teach the children the importance of being kind. We model this importance by letting the children experience how we can show kindness for them. We teach the children skills and strategies to show kindness and discuss how we can care for different people in different ways.
We are honest
It is our role as teachers at Fetcham Village Infant School to teach children the difference between an imaginative story, and a lie with unkind intentions. Explaining and exploring these differences with children can help them to understand what lying is, and why it is wrong, and this understanding underpins other activities which help to develop honesty.
We are curious
At Fetcham Village Infant School, we make the most of every opportunity to nurture children's natural curiosity and children are encouraged to explore and question the world around them. By developing children's questioning and investigative skills, they learn to look a little deeper and engage with their surroundings in a more meaningful way.
We try our best
Learning is not supposed to be easy. We all have different skills and attributes and need to challenge ourselves in different ways. At Fetcham Village Infant School we encourage children to face these challenges with confidence and an attitude to learn and improve. By trying our best, we can feel proud of all our achievements.
We are brave
In an ever-demanding world, children at Fetcham Village Infant School will be taught how courage and determination can support their own growth and development. A key responsibility of the staff is to challenge the children but support them when they make mistakes. Children will therefore understand that mistakes help us learn and grow for the better.
We work well together
We want to help the children at Fetcham Village Infant School realise how working alongside others with a teamwork approach is truly a wonderful experience. In order to do this, children will firstly be taught to appreciate their own value to others, then identify and value other children's assets. Learning at Fetcham Village Infant School is a collaborative process, rooted in effective and positive communication. Co-operation goes beyond this and extends the children's social skills further.

Cook together - measuring, weighing, and timing
Play board games and card games

pageCache.text:
Open Mornings for September 2027
Accessibility Statement
How accessible this website is, and how to tell us about any problems
This statement applies to the Fetcham Village Infant School website at fetcham.surrey.sch.uk. It does not cover any other website we link to.
This website is run by Fetcham Village Infant School. We want as many people as possible to be able to use it, whatever their needs. That means you should be able to do the following.
AbilityNet has advice on making your device easier to use if you have a disability.
Navigate the whole site using a keyboard
Pause the background video on our homepage
How accessible this website is
We know that some parts of this website are not fully accessible. The issues we are aware of are listed below.
Some documents are published as PDFs — including policies, newsletters and curriculum maps. Older PDFs, and those we receive from other organisations, may not be tagged for screen readers, and some may be scans of printed pages.
These documents were published before September 2018 or come from third parties, and are exempt under the accessibility regulations. We will provide any of them in an accessible format on request.
Our admission and consent forms for new starters are provided through Tally, and our school calendar is drawn from Google Calendar.
These are third-party services and we do not control their code. If you have difficulty using any of them, please contact the school office and we will help you complete the form or give you the dates you need.
Getting information in a different format
If you need anything on this website in a different format — large print, easy read, audio recording, braille, or simply read aloud to you over the phone — please ask. Tell us what you need and which page or document it relates to, and we will do our best to help.
We will consider your request and get back to you within 5 school days.

Reporting accessibility problems with this website
We are always looking to improve the accessibility of this website. If you find a problem that is not already listed on this page, or you think we are not meeting the accessibility requirements, please contact us or email info@fetcham.surrey.sch.uk. Please tell us the address of the page and what the problem was, and we will look into it.
Enforcement procedure
The Equality and Human Rights Commission (EHRC) is responsible for enforcing the Public Sector Bodies (Websites and Mobile Applications) (No. 2) Accessibility Regulations 2018 (the “accessibility regulations”).
If you are not happy with how we respond to your complaint, contact the Equality Advisory and Support Service (EASS).
Technical information about this website’s accessibility
Fetcham Village Infant School is committed to making its website accessible, in accordance with the Public Sector Bodies (Websites and Mobile Applications) (No. 2) Accessibility Regulations 2018.
This website is partially compliant with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines version 2.1 AA standard, because of the non-compliances and exemptions listed in “How accessible this website is” above.
What we are doing to improve accessibility
We check accessibility whenever we add or change a page, and we build new pages to meet the WCAG 2.1 AA standard. We are working to replace older PDFs with accessible web pages or tagged documents as they come up for review.
If a document you need is not accessible, please ask us and we will provide it in a format that works for you.
Preparation of this accessibility statement
This statement was prepared on 2 September 2026. It was last reviewed on 2 September 2026.
This website was last tested in September 2026. The test was carried out by the school as an internal review of the site against the WCAG 2.1 AA standard, covering a sample of pages from each section of the site.
